questions.question: Manoah's wife had no children. What did the angel of the LORD tell her would happen?

answers.text: She would give birth to a son
She would care for an orphan from her clan
She would live to see Israel set free

questions.question: What did the angel of the LORD say Manoah's promised son would do for Israel?

answers.text: Begin to set Israel free from the Philistines
Make peace between Israel and the Philistines
Rule over Israel as its king

questions.question: When Manoah offered to prepare a young goat for the angel of the LORD, what did the angel say?

answers.text: Offer it to the LORD instead
He would gladly stay and eat it
Save it for the day of the birth
